items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I liked also, very much, Walter Johnson. Walter Johnson was the best drummer I heard playing an open-top cymbal...

ctx.x: I never worked much with Kaiser. I was

very fond of Kaiser's drumming. I heard him with Fletcher Henderson's band years before in Detroit, before we came to New York. And I liked also, very much, Walter Johnson. Walter Johnson was the best drummer I heard playing an open-top cymbal, big cymbal on top of the drum and just letting it ring behind the solos.

Walter Johnson David Thompson was doing that when he came to New York in 1934 or so, that open cymbal. See, Sid, Big Sid and Chick Webb and Gene Krupa, they weren't doing that. I don't believe they were playing that, just letting that cymbal ring like that, which became -- and then of course Joe Jones came with Basie. He made quite a little change in style. But what he did still didn't take away from the greatness of people like Gene Krupa and Cozy Cole and Big Sid. Big Sid was a great drummer, regardless of the…
